initialize.instructions: FigCraft is an interface design tool (Figma-class): pages hold frames, groups, shapes, text, components and instances, with auto layout, styles, variables and prototyping. Coordinates are page units (1 unit = 1 px at 100% zoom), x right and y DOWN. create_node and set_properties take x/y RELATIVE TO THE PARENT (the page when there is no parent, so page coordinates); inspect_document reports both x/y relative to the parent frame (groups don't count) and absoluteBounds in page coordinates. Children of an auto-layout frame are positioned by the layout (set layout, gap, padding, mainAlign, crossAlign, sizingH/sizingV instead). Every menu item, panel action and shortcut is a command: find ids and params with list_commands (use a filter) and run them with run_command, or several as one undo step with batch. Commands act on `ids` when given, else on the selection; new layers become the selection. Colours are "#RRGGBB" or "#RRGGBBAA". Verify your work: inspect_document / get_node return the layer tree as JSON (check sizes, fills, layout, overrides), and screenshot returns a PNG of the page or of given layers to look at. undo/redo step through history. Comments: comment.list returns threads (text, anchor node id, frame, page, x/y, replies); fix open ones, reply with what changed, then resolve (a reply reopens a thread). To react to new feedback, call wait_for_changes {after, timeoutMs} and pass the returned cursor back. Resources: figcraft://document, figcraft://node/{id}, figcraft://command/{id}, figcraft://comments. prompts/list has workflows, including fix_comments. Backend: attached to the FigCraft app at 127.0.0.1:7979.

note: Initialize/tool discovery only; no design edits sent
